title: Emyoyo gy’Omukutu
intro: Ogenda okuddayo mu mulembe omufuzi atalina kisa we yali asaba okwewaayo okujjuvu eri bakatonda ab’obulimba. Ekibiina ekitono eky’emyoyo egy’okwewaayo kyagaana, era ne kyolekagana n’ekibonerezo eky’amaanyi ennyo ne kifuuka ekikolimiddwa emirembe gyonna. Emboozi yaabwe ewulikika okuyita mu Quran ng’obujulizi bw’okukkiriza okutakyukakyuka. Osobola okuzuula ekibinja kino ekinywevu?
clues: Twabeera mu nsi eyali wansi w’obufuzi obw’ekibogwe obw’omufuzi eyali ayagala okusinza bakatonda ab’obulimba
Ekitundu kyaffe kyayolekagana n’okuyigganyizibwa okw’amaanyi olw’okukkiriza kwaffe kwokka mu Allah yekka
Omufuzi yalagira nti omukutu omunene gusimibwe gufukibwemu ennimi z’omuliro ez’amaanyi
Olw’okuba twagaana okwegaana okukkiriza kwaffe, twasuulibwa mu kinnya ekyo eyakaayakana omu ku omu
Emboozi yaffe yafuuka ekitundu ku Quran, era abaatuyigganya ne bakolimirwa emirembe gyonna
Surah ewandiika ekizibu kyaffe etuumiddwa erinnya ly’obubonero obukulu obw’omu ggulu obw’eggulu

trial.label: Okugezesebwa kwaffe
options: Okuyokebwa nga mulamu mu kinnya ekirimu omuliro
Okubeera nga basibiddwa mu mpuku okumala emyaka mingi
trial.answer: Okuyokebwa nga mulamu mu kinnya ekirimu omuliro

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu
options: Empuku enkweke nga mulimu embwa omwesigwa
Empagi empanvu ez’ekibuga eky’edda ekyali kigenda okuzikirizibwa
Ebifo eby’okubeeramu ku nsozi ebiyooleddwa mu njazi ez’amayinja

outcome.label: Ebyavaamu byaffe
options: Twattibwa era abayigganya ne bakolimirwa emirembe gyonna
Twakyusibwa ne tufuuka enkima olw’okusobya kwaffe
Empewo ey’amaanyi eyali ewuuma yatusaanyaawo ffenna
Okukaaba okumu okw’amaanyi kwamenyaamenya okubeerawo kwaffe
outcome.answer: Twattibwa era abayigganya ne bakolimirwa emirembe gyonna

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
